question: Does increasing seed-10 Sobol density from N=64 to N=256 recover any in-basin landing at fixed truth-ω with LM polish?
hypothesis: Higher Sobol density will not recover seed-10's truth basin; seed 10 is in the multi-solution / under-determination regime, not a clean inversion failure.
narrative_md: Extending seed-10 Sobol density N=64 → N=256 yields 0/256 in-basin landings at fixed truth-ω; closest landing only 12.95° (still outside the strict 5° basin). Competing basins grow sub-linearly (49 → 76 → 123). Seed 10 (1.055 rotations in the window, slowest tumbler) is observationally under-determined — many (q0, ω) attractors within ~10x of truth-MSE. Pure SO(3) Sobol + LM at fixed truth-ω cannot recover seed-10-class seeds at any feasible density; ρ-band classification (s013) decides failure vs multi-solution.
